title: Ghar ko chodha shaah ne
body:
Ghar ko chodha shaah ne jungle basa ne ke liye
karbala me aaye the jannat me jaane ke liye
<<DIVIDER>>
Zohr ko zainab se jab milne gaye ghar me hussain
koi dyodi par na tha parda uthaane ke liye
<<DIVIDER>>
Sheh uthe padhkaar namaaze sub'ha mehshaar ho gaya
Hazrte zainab chalee kapde pin'haane ke liye
<<DIVIDER>>
kehti thi maa khat mere akber ko tha paighaame marg
Ye jawaani aayi thi goya bulaane ke liye
<<DIVIDER>>
thi sada zahra ki zainab margaya tera hussain
ghar me jaa beti safe maatam bichaane ke liye
